text: Illustration. A different car, April 20th account
In April, an empty Waymo was swept into Salado Creek.
observed: 14.0 to 14.6 s creek wide shot with a slow drift; the car sits level and half submerged, a pale wake line now trails from its nose toward the right, limestone ledges slide away at right.
